digest_preimages.reservation_digest: Canonical object with EXACT fields: schema_version,namespace,reservation_id,authority_id,authority_epoch,session_id,session_header_sha256,runtime_profile_sha256,source_revision,project,deployment_verification_reference,coordination_policy_reference,host_root_binding_sha256,requested_at,freshness_deadline,nonce,request_id,request_digest,acknowledgment_digest,previous_authority_revision,previous_ledger_digest,previous_witness_digest,expected_next_revision,run_id,run_identity,fencing_token,operator_authorization_reference. Immutable across records; no mutable state/sequence/receipt fields.
